Messages.Author: Marko Puumalainen
Messages.Body:
Can Telepathic Vote Counting be used after the vote is lost?
What about after a Political Backlash has been played?

BTW, I don't see what's so confusing about Hidden Lurker. It clearly
says "This vampire now enters _the_ combat...". It does not say that
it "attacks the minion" or somthing like that which would allow some
other minion to block. The text clearly indicates that _the combat_ is
not over yet. The fact that it is an action card just means that it
taps the playing vampire, that needs to be untapped and have obfuscate
to be able to play HL. I just love that card with Marty Lech and the flame
thrower... did I mention IR Goggles?

))marko

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
ma...@beta.hut.fi (Marko Puumalainen) writes:

>BTW, I don't see what's so confusing about Hidden Lurker. It clearly
>says "This vampire now enters _the_ combat...". It does not say that
>it "attacks the minion" or somthing like that which would allow some
>other minion to block. The text clearly indicates that _the combat_ is
>not over yet. The fact that it is an action card just means that it
>taps the playing vampire, that needs to be untapped and have obfuscate
>to be able to play HL. I just love that card with Marty Lech and the flame
>thrower... did I mention IR Goggles?

Well, you score big points for using the card rationally in spite of the
incorrect symbol on the card.
(Tom's "ruling" that it should be an action modifier makes the card
behave as you've been playing it.)

The thing is: Action cards describe events that *don't* happen if the
action is blocked.

Computer hacking: Bleed at +1. It doesn't say it can be blocked.
All actions (Bleed, hunt, equip, 4th Tradition: accounting, call a vote, etc.)
can be blocked. Directed actions by the directee, other actions by the
Predator or Prey.

anyway, I'm fairly sure the "_the_" you emphasised is not on the card, not that
it would change anything.

Well, with Fast Reaction, you take a new action (and tapping [sic] the

vampire) of entering an old combat.

Fast Reaction is a Reaction card, which cannot be blocked and it says:
"Tap this reacting vampire"
Hidden Lurker says "Tap this Vampire". Why would it say that if it were an
action? All actions "Tap this Minion"

>Would it be more correct if my prey could use another minion to block
>the action (the action of "entering an old combat")?

NO. That's exactly what is incorrect about HL being an Action - my Prey or
Predator can block the action of entering an old combat

>>anyway, I'm fairly sure the "_the_" you emphasised is not on the

Messages.Author: CurtAdams
Messages.Body:
ma...@beta.hut.fi (Marko Puumalainen) writes:

>Did anyone know the answer to my original question of whether
>Telepathic Vote Counting can be played after losing vote, or after
>Political Backlash has been played?

The vote can't be over until it's no longer possible to cast votes. Hence
in either situation it's too late for TVC.

Curt Adams (curt...@aol.com)
